## Warm-Up: Song Maker

## Strudel
[Strudel](https://strudel.cc/workshop/getting-started/) is a browser-based live-coding environment where you can make music with code.

### Tutorial
[Click here to start learning how to use Strudel.](https://strudel.cc/workshop/first-sounds/)
